response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has strong software engineering experience with a diverse background in full-stack development, AI-agent infrastructure, and performance optimization, but lacks direct experience with SoC modeling, AI accelerator architectures, or hardware-software co-design required for this role. His educational background (Bachelor's in CS) and 12+ years of software development do not meet the preferred PhD requirement, and his resume does not highlight deep-learning workload optimization or GPU architecture expertise.
strengths: Strong software engineering background with expertise in performance optimization for real-time systems (e.g., low-latency apps with Dlang at Dunnhumby)
Experience with AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling, showing adaptability to emerging technologies
Proven track record of building scalable systems (e.g., GISCollective platform handling thousands of users)
concerns: No direct experience with SoC modeling, IP integration, or hardware-software co-design required for the role
Lacks demonstrated expertise in AI accelerator architecture, deep-learning workload optimization, or GPU architecture analysis
Educational background (Bachelor's) falls short of the preferred PhD requirement for this principal-level position
